Academic Programs

Our comprehensive educational programs are designed to nurture students at every stage of their development journey.

Every Stage of Learning

Choose a level to see what children learn and where it is taught.

Creche

Ages: 6 months - 2 years

A nurturing environment where infants and toddlers receive personalized care while developing essential early skills through play-based learning.

Focus

  • Personalized care
  • Play-based learning
  • Essential early skills

Taught at all four campuses.

Kindergarten

Ages: 3 - 5 years

A vibrant learning environment where children develop social skills, creativity, and foundational academic concepts through guided play and exploration.

Learning areas in the GES kindergarten curriculum

  • Language and Literacy
  • Numeracy
  • Our World Our People
  • Creative Arts

Taught at all four campuses.

Primary School

Ages: 6 - 11 years

A comprehensive curriculum that builds strong academic foundations in literacy, numeracy, science, and social studies while fostering critical thinking skills.

Subjects in the GES primary curriculum

  • English Language
  • Ghanaian Language
  • Mathematics
  • Science
  • Our World Our People
  • History
  • Religious and Moral Education
  • Creative Arts
  • Physical Education
  • Computing

Primary 1 to 3 at all four campuses; Primary 4 to 6 at First Stop.

Junior High School

Ages: 12 - 14 years

An advanced curriculum preparing students for higher education with specialized subjects, research projects, and leadership opportunities. In JHS 3, students sit the Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE).

Subjects in the GES junior high curriculum

  • English Language
  • Ghanaian Language
  • Mathematics
  • Science
  • Social Studies
  • Religious and Moral Education
  • Career Technology
  • Creative Arts and Design
  • Computing
  • French
  • Physical and Health Education

JHS 1 to 3 are taught at the First Stop campus.

Subjects follow the Ghana Education Service standards-based curriculum. Ask the school office about the subjects offered at each campus.
